evidence_quotes.agenda: No their-agenda question asked; customer's separation/moving context was shared unprompted but rep never asked for concerns directly.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Agenda question never asked — 15/15 via the no-concern-raised exception.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: 'If ever the move takes less than this, you will only be charged for how much time we use' present; no rate/experience line, no self-prep tip, no fair-check.

top_strength: Handled a sensitive personal context (separation move) with a light, professional touch and made the explicit close ask, which the customer accepted.
coaching_note: Bring in the agenda question early and land at least the damage-coverage differentiator — the customer flagged a painting, a perfect opening that went unused.
